05 / FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Everything you need
to know before you build.

Clear answers on construction scope, grey structure packages, pricing transparency, and site execution in Karachi.

What construction services do you provide in Karachi?

Fazal & Sons provides end-to-end building contractor services including turnkey residential construction (villas, bungalows, multi-story houses), commercial developments, grey structure contracting, and specialized reinforced concrete (RCC) works across Karachi.

What is included in your grey structure construction package?

Our grey structure package covers excavation, subterranean compaction, termite proofing, underground and overhead water tanks, raft or strip foundations, Deformed Grade-60 steel reinforcement, certified concrete pouring, brickwork/block masonry, and conduit rough-ins for plumbing and electrical systems.

Which areas of Karachi do you build in?

Our office is located at 1-K/46 Barkati Corner (First Floor), Near Old Nayab Cinema, Commercial Area Nazimabad, Karachi. We actively manage and execute construction sites across Nazimabad, North Nazimabad, Gulshan-e-Iqbal, PECHS, Clifton, DHA, Gulistan-e-Johar, Bahria Town, and neighboring residential and commercial sectors in Karachi.

How do we get an estimate or quote for our plot?

You can use our enquiry builder below or reach out directly on WhatsApp at +92 300 3732847 with your plot size, location, and architectural preferences. We arrange on-site consultations to discuss site logistics, material specifications, and transparent cost estimates.
